meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 上网搜资料、取网页正文,还能把结果筛成学术论文
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要上网查资料、抓取网页或找学术论文
copy.tagline_en: Search the web, pull page text, and narrow results to academic papers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often search the web, grab page content, or hunt for papers

howto.what: Claude 会通过 Exa 做网页搜索和 URL 内容抓取。搜索时可指定研究论文类别或限定学术域名;抓取支持一次传入多个网址和学术 PDF。使用前需配置 EXA_API_KEY。
howto.when: 当你说要搜索、查资料或抓取某个网页时触发;需要学术来源筛选(如限定研究论文类别)时也走它。

say.note: 用 Exa 做网页搜索并返回结果

howto.what_en: Claude gains web search and URL extraction via Exa. Searches can bias toward scholarly sources (research-paper category, academic domain allowlists); extraction takes multiple URLs or academic PDFs per call. Requires EXA_API_KEY.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search, look something up, fetch a page, or extract an article, including requests that need academic source filtering.
